title: Ingestion Client v2 - Batch transcription config
description: Config for files uploaded to audio-input/batch/. Asynchronous batch transcription (v3.2).

locales.description: First entry = primary locale. Two or more entries enable language identification (base models only; 2-10 candidates).

diarization.description: Separate speakers on mono audio. maxSpeakers > 2 uses the richer diarization model.

timeToLiveHours.description: How long results are retained on the service (6h-31d). Recommended 48.

displayFormWordLevelTimestamps.description: Word-level timestamps on the display form (required for Whisper models).

model.description: Optional custom or Whisper model 'self' URI. Empty = latest base model.
